feed.title: Type IL Cement & Concrete Index: daily digest
feed.subtitle: A living index of standards, research, guidance, field experience and news on Type IL portland-limestone cement (ASTM C595 / AASHTO M 240, 5-15% limestone) and concrete made with it. Updated daily.

entry.title: October 30, 2026: 28 new resources
entry.content:
28 new resources in the Type IL Cement & Concrete Index.

Durability

  • Limestone-rich binders beyond clinker reduction: durability as the sustainability boundary (critical review) (J. Sustainable Cement-Based Materials, Paper, 2026)
  • Durability of Portland-Limestone Cement Pastes in Citric Acid (Gebremariam, Shakouri; ACI Materials Journal) (ACI, Paper, 2026-09-01)
  • Durability of Fly Ash and Limestone Concrete Under Combined Sulfate and Chloride Attack (Int. J. Concrete Structures and Materials, Paper, 2026)

Carbon, GWP and EPDs

  • Devils Slide IL(10) ASTM C595 Blended Cement EPD (issued Feb 16, 2026, valid to 2031) (Amrize, EPD, 2026-02-16)

State DOT acceptance

  • NYSDOT Standard Specifications Vol. 4, Section 700 (701-03 Type IL; base portland cement must be Type II or II(MH)) (NYSDOT, Spec, 2026-09-01)
  • INDOT 2026 Standard Specifications, Division 900 Materials Details (Type IL per AASHTO M 240) (INDOT, Spec, 2026)

Field issues and finishing

  • Best Practices for Placing and Finishing Type IL Cement Concrete (Basham, Kim; Central Pre-Mix, Spokane) (Washington Aggregates & Concrete Assn., Presentation, 2026-03-05)

Precast, floors, bridges

  • Design of self-consolidating precast concrete using powdered limestone (Type IL SCC dissertation) (Georgia Tech SMARTech, Dissertation, 2018-07-26)

Research gaps

  • Hydration Heat in a Mass Concrete and a Thin Slab with Limestone Blended Cement (Int. J. Materials Science and Engineering, Paper, 2017)

Standards and specifications

  • WK94958 Revision of C595: sulfate-resistant Type IL based on ASTM C452 (ASTM, Work item, 2026)

Microcracking and the interfacial transition zone

  • Systematic Study of Type 1L Cement for Mixture Optimization and Carbon Reduction (Sung, He, Lu, Feng; JTRP) (Purdue University / INDOT, Report, 2025)
  • Study of interfacial transition zone in concrete with SCMs (Kotlanova et al.) (J. Phys.: Conf. Ser. 2341, Paper, 2022)
  • Raman spectroscopy of ITZ in concrete doped with limestone powder and metakaolin (Krejci Kotlanova, Masek) (IOP Conf. Ser.: Mater. Sci. Eng. 1039, Paper, 2021)
  • Mechanism of microstructural modification of the ITZ by using blended materials (limestone filler, slag) (Ghent University (biblio), Paper, 2015)
  • Insights into the mechanisms of nucleation and growth of C-S-H on fillers (Ouyang, Koleva, Ye, van Breugel) (Materials and Structures, Paper, 2017)
  • Hydration and microstructural development of portland limestone cement-based materials (Georgia Tech SMARTech, Dissertation, 2016-06-15)
  • Portland Limestone Cement with Fly Ash: Freeze-Thaw Durability and Microstructure Studies (North Dakota State University, Thesis)
  • Shear Fracture Toughness and Structure of ITZ of Limestone Concrete with Different Aggregate Grain Size (Golewski) (Materials 18(17):3954, Paper, 2025)
  • Effect of Aggregate, Cement, and Mineral Admixtures on the Microstructure of the Transition Zone (Mehta, Monteiro) (MRS Proceedings 114, Paper, 1987)
  • Experimental study of the chemo-mechanical properties of the ITZ of concrete (Girboveanu et al.) (IOP Conf. Ser.: Earth Environ. Sci. 664, Paper, 2021)
  • Influence of aggregate size and volume fraction on shrinkage induced micro-cracking of concrete and mortar (Grassl, Wong, Buenfeld) (Cement and Concrete Research, Paper, 2010)
  • Influence of inclusion rigidity on shrinkage induced micro-cracking of cementitious materials (Li et al.) (Cement and Concrete Composites, Paper, 2020)
  • Effect of aggregates on drying shrinkage microcracking in cement-based composites (Bisschop, van Mier) (Materials and Structures, Paper, 2002)
  • 3D imaging techniques for characterising microcracks in cement-based materials (Mac, Yio, Desbois, Casanova, Wong, Buenfeld) (Cement and Concrete Research, Paper, 2021)
  • Acoustic emission waveform characterization of crack origin and mode in fractured and ASR damaged concrete (Farnam, Geiker, Bentz, Weiss) (Cement and Concrete Composites, Paper, 2015)
  • Application of digital image correlation to study the influence of w/c on the ITZ (Zhang et al.) (Construction and Building Materials, Paper, 2023)
  • A Multiscale and Multimethod Approach to Assess and Mitigate Concrete Damage Due to ASR (Weise et al.) (Advanced Engineering Materials, Paper, 2022)
  • Damage evaluation for freezing-thawing affected concrete by automated panoramic fluorescent microscope (Li et al.) (CRC Press (Concrete Repair, Rehabilitation and Retrofitting IV), Paper, 2015)

Index note: Added 10 resources (R65-R74): 2026 durability papers (critical review, citric acid, combined sulfate-chloride), Amrize Devils Slide IL(10) EPD, NYSDOT and INDOT 2026 specs, WACA finishing training deck, ASTM WK94958 work item, plus first SCC and mass concrete sources. Updated durability, standards, DOT, carbon, field takeaways, key issues and gaps.

Index note: Added 18 resources (R75-R92) and new topic 'Microcracking and the interfacial transition zone'. Tagged durability, scm, strength and fresh as relevant. Added a key issue and a gap. All entries verified via Crossref or the source pages.

Index note: Corrected the title to Type IL. Verified DOIs against Crossref and fixed dates for R16, R33, R39, R44, R52, R78 and R80 (R81 set to undated), corrected the titles and dates of R29 and R64, and replaced the dead R48 link. Normalized type labels, tagged R66 and R74 as news, and added an 'added' date to every resource. The site now has a static HTML version of every page, per-topic pages, a sitemap and daily and weekly feeds.
